title: ShopCoach line builder names its editors Title and Description
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154711 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154711 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Asset-A} has a year, make and model filled in (for example 2018 Freightliner Cascadia), so ShopCoach can suggest lines for it.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. Click New Line.
  3. Click AI SHOPCOACH LINE BUILDER.
  4. Describe the job (for example brakes grinding) and click Build Lines.
  5. Wait until suggested lines appear.
  6. Click the title cell of the first suggested line.
  7. Read the label of the editor that opens.
  8. Press Escape.
  9. Click the description cell of the same line.
  10. Read the label of the editor that opens.
  11. Close the builder without adding any line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: the editor is labeled "Title".
  • Step 10: the editor is labeled "Description".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10131 (Story 2, The ShopCoach Line Builder); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S2-R1, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-006; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).
